subject.title: fix(codex): continue after source-reply delivery instead of terminating turn

question: Should this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 become the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106961, and should the landing change include the sibling PR's clearer `final` schema guidance?
rationale: Both branches implement the core continuation rule and preserve recovery telemetry, but their test and schema scope differs; selecting the canonical branch and acceptable live proof requires ownership judgment rather than an automated repair.

options.title: Adopt this PR plus guidance
options.body: Use this branch's regression coverage, port the unambiguous `final` guidance if desired, rebase it, and require live exactly-once Discord/Codex proof before merge.

options.title: Adopt the sibling PR
options.body: Select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 if its schema-guidance scope is preferred, then close this PR only after the sibling has equivalent live proof and is a viable landing candidate.

recommendation.title: Adopt this PR plus guidance
recommendation.body: Use this branch's regression coverage, port the unambiguous `final` guidance if desired, rebase it, and require live exactly-once Discord/Codex proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the Codex-specific source-reply completion boundary and included live validation of the same delivery path.
